canada.title: Toronto’s new council is meeting for the first time. Here's who is new and what to expect

canada.title: What Hamilton's new Mayor Keanin Loomis wants from his new, less experienced, city council
canada.summary: Hamilton Mayor Keanin Loomis said returning councillors have already shown "a lot of goodwill," and they'll likely need a lot of patience and grace as the new members start figuring things out.

canada.title: Fatal police shootings in Nunavik shattered trust. Can these new intervention teams help?
canada.summary: Saqijuq's Mobile Intervention Team (MIT) in Kuujjuaq is pairing intervention workers with officers in an effort to reduce police involvement, arrests and use of force. It comes on the heels of years of distrust between Inuit and the Nunavik Police Service.
